posts.text:
We must drag every state official who manipulated their maps to silence Black voters before Congress, and we've got to investigate if any illegal racial discrimination took place. 

We deserve answers.
posts.summary: Demands congressional investigation of racial gerrymandering by state officials

posts.text:
I just voted to end President Trump's war in Iran.

This reckless and illegal war has left us worse off. It has been a failure of leadership to the highest degree.
posts.summary: Opposes Trump's Iran military action as reckless and illegal

posts.text:
Donald Trump's economy is a complete and total failure. 

It's been nearly two years, and his administration is still blaming Joe Biden!
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump administration's economic record as complete failure
posts.quote:

posts.text: All he does is make things more expensive.

posts.text:
I just voted NO on Jay Clayton's nomination to be Director of National Intelligence.

Why should someone who can’t acknowledge who won the 2020 election oversee our intelligence agencies?

posts.text: Donald Trump handed billionaires a tax cut but left our children with the bill.
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump tax cuts for billionaires as shifting burden to children

posts.text: This Buffalo Soldiers Day, I’m thinking of the first all-Black Army regiments formed after the Civil War. Despite facing discrimination and hate, these brave soldiers served our country valiantly. The patriotism and sacrifice of these heroes live on.
posts.summary: Honors Black military service and sacrifice against historical discrimination

posts.text:

Now, measles cases are breaking new records. 
 
Reckless rhetoric has deadly consequences.

posts.text:
In 2024, 300 billionaires and their families donated 19% of all money spent on federal elections. 

We need billionaires to spend less on elections and more in taxes.

Enough is enough. 
 
Measles cases keep breaking new records and all our Health Secretary has done is pour fuel on the fire. 
 
RFK Jr. must be fired immediately.
posts.summary: Calls for firing RFK Jr. over measles outbreak response

posts.text:
House Republicans held hands in prayer as they voted to take food away from hungry families. 

How can you pray for your neighbor, and then literally turn around and prey ON your neighbor with policies that crush the poor.
posts.summary: Criticizes House Republicans for voting to cut food assistance to poor families
posts.quote:

There is one effective way to reduce the spread and severity of measles: Vaccination. 
 
And RFK Jr. has undermined it at every turn. 
 
He is a hazard to our health and must resign.

posts.text: GOOD NEWS: My bill to cap the cost of insulin at $35 is officially moving forward. It's well past time to get this done. Let’s call this up for a full vote ASAP.

I just rolled out a comprehensive plan to fix and strengthen voting rights in America. 

For too long, we’ve sat on our hands while this problem just gets worse and worse. 

Enough talk. It’s past time for action.
